adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. JS `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a type like `some_admin_model` would become `some-admin_model` and fail to match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `some-admin-model`, falling back to the non-admin base path. The diff doesn’t show any current admin model names with multiple underscores (existing ones are `plugin`, `site_customization`, `embeddable_host`), so it’s not a present defect, but it is a real fragility introduced by this change.
